recent_updates.body:
Implemented one growing standard component library shared across Studio profiles. Checkout and installed Studio use the marked repository library when available; standalone installed Studio exposes a writable app-data fallback, ships Prismatic Ball, and imports nonconflicting fallback additions or history-backed updates when the repository returns. Only explicit library create/update operations mutate it. Legacy IDs and revisions, scene links, mounted fallbacks, and forks remain intact.

Candidate `add6587b21410ea42699c6985553ff8a0708ba92` was independently accepted and integrated as main `ebf3a72ac71532799310cebabaae2c6f5fb9a470`. GPT-5.6 Sol high was used because filesystem migration, cross-process exclusion, immutable revision history, and installed/checkout path semantics required broader concurrency review.

Implemented Preview menu capture at the selected output resolution. Save frame PNG uses the existing worker capture path and trusted main/preload save IPC. Record/Stop streams bounded MediaRecorder WebM chunks to protected sibling temporary files, finalizes finite duration metadata without buffering the clip, and commits atomically. Runtime/output replacement finalizes the fixed-size clip; errors and shutdown cancel/drain partial writes. UI file saves support valid 3840×2160 PNGs while agent results retain their 8 MiB boundary. Source skill documentation describes the delivered UI behavior and separate tool limit.

Scene and component controls use the same animation editor. Flat scene bindings use the declared schema identity; base values remain independently editable and saved. Incompatible bindings stay disabled rather than retargeting. Display-only animation samples use the existing bounded UI update cadence.
Source: 0ae299d6671a7687e41811f95d9c673d4c3a378d.
Independent review and integration pending.

LUX-97 adds optional named groups to numeric control declarations and renders them as nested disclosures inside Controls. SDK 0.2 scenes and SDK 0.4 component/exposure aliases preserve group metadata and declared order. Ungrouped controls retain the existing row UI. The shipped authoring skill and noise-sphere example describe meaningful grouping while keeping small sets simple.

Source: commit 477632e6a1866a448a96d424a6bf93dd24e30ab4 on codex/control-groups, based on 9e5ee83580f85194300a419b0ae47b35313f73e0.
Record approved nested control sections and default agent authoring convention; preserve existing scope.
